title: Host-architecture brief: bring its "unknown place counts in every worktree" target in line with the landed per-session scoping (204b95b)
outcome: docs/features/host-architecture.md (committed 6ab70dc, base 28e9ed5) states as target that an unplaced command, and an admitted observation not yet resolved, counts as a possible write in every worktree: section 2.6, section 4.4, section 8.3, and the fifth risk of section 12. Entry condition 2 of step 10a says another session is a writer for its whole turn. Since the brief's base, 204b95b (in train-1 merge c4197f3) has landed the coordinator's option C: a command TermAl cannot place counts where its session works (its workdir's worktree and its turn's named root), not in every worktree; being in a turn fences no carried gate; a Claude command that only reads counts nowhere. By the brief's own rule (section 9.5), a correctness fix that lands first is part of the base and is preserved. The target text should say so: an unplaced or unresolved observation counts in every worktree its session may work in, not in every worktree; step 10a's entry conditions carry the landed carried-gate rules. Also, section 5.3's table lists `work next --peek --context-generation termal-<n>` for the session's orientation read; once the read-only-peek change lands, a read-only delegation child's read carries no generation.
acceptance: docs/features/host-architecture.md states the landed per-session scoping of unplaced and unresolved observations and the carried-gate rules of 204b95b wherever it now says 'every worktree' or treats a turn as a writer, and section 5.3 reflects the read-only orientation read; the change is docs only and passes the review pair.
